title: About Me
description: Get to know more about my journey, passion, and what drives me in the world of technology.
bio: Hello! I'm Rahul Seervi, a passionate B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student specializing in Big Data Analytics. My journey in technology began with a curiosity about how data can transform decision-making and create meaningful impact.

I have hands-on experience in developing applications using Java, React, and various database technologies. My projects range from interactive games like UNO to sophisticated systems like Traffic Video Analysis System using Next.js and Canvas API.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or diving deep into the latest trends in big data and analytics.
